mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Funds Rate is held constant for two consecutive months above 2.5%, market expectations of future rate cuts decline, lowering real discount rates and boosting equity present-value pricing, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: FOMC holds rates steady in a restrictive environment
failure_condition: Over 60-day horizon, SPX 60-day forward returns are not statistically different from the 30-day prior period (t-test p > 0.05), or FEDFUNDS re-enters tightening by the end of the horizon.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in monthly employment growth (PAYEMS) accompanied by a simultaneous decline in unemployment (UNRATE) signals a strengthening labor market, which raises consumer confidence and corporate earnings expectations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases by >10% month-over-month while UNRATE falls by >0.5 percentage points in the same month
failure_condition: In triggered months, SPX 20-day forward returns are negative or flat, and alternative labor indicators (e.g., INDPRO) show no correlation with returns.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly expansion in industrial production (INDPRO) above its 12-month moving average, with no concurrent inflation acceleration (CPIAUCSL < 0.3%), predicts that firms will accelerate capital spending to meet demand, boosting equity valuations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO > INDPRO_12MA and CPIAUCSL < 0.3 for two consecutive months
regime_hint: Economic expansion with deflationary inflation pressures
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative, or INDPRO decelerates in the following month despite the signal.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden drop in consumer price inflation (CPIAUCSL) below 2.0% accompanied by a rise in retail sales (HOUST) indicates a normalization of price pressures and improved consumer sentiment, which elevates equity risk premia and produces positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL < 2.0 and HOUST increases by >2% month-over-month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >50% of similar triggers, or alternative demand indicators (e.g., GDPC1) show no correlation.

mechanism_narrative: When the 3-month moving average of FEDFUNDS falls below 4.0%, market pricing of future rate cuts increases, lowering real discount rates and supporting equity valuations, which should produce positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are flat or negative, or FEDFUNDS re-enters tightening before the horizon ends.

mechanism_narrative: A consecutive decline in unemployment (UNRATE) below 4.0% followed by two months of rising payrolls (PAYEMS) predicts wage growth momentum that boosts consumer spending and corporate profits, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE < 4.0 for two consecutive months and PAYEMS increases by >20,000 in the following month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative, or wage growth (PAYEMS) decelerates in the next observation window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp contraction in industrial production (INDPRO) accompanied by a sustained rise in retail activity (HOUST) suggests supply-side bottlenecks persisting into demand recovery, which can amplify equity risk premia and drive negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO < INDPRO_12MA for two consecutive months and HOUST increases by >3% month-over-month
regime_hint: Supply disruption during early demand recovery
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly worse than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or alternative supply indicators (RSAFS) show no correlation.

mechanism_narrative: During a sharp rise in inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.0%) with no offsetting increase in employment (PAYEMS), investors anticipate tighter policy, which elevates real interest rates and compresses equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL > 3.0 and PAYEMS < PAYEMS_12MA for two consecutive months
regime_hint: High inflation with weak labor market
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not statistically negative (t-test p > 0.05), or alternative inflation indicators (e.g., GDPC1) contradict the signal.
